title: Just Juice Green Mint 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Mint Range Green Mint Shortfill delivers the cool and mildly sweet flavour of spearmint, offering a smooth and refreshing vape without being too intense. The balanced spearmint flavour creates a clean and fresh exhale, ideal for vapers who prefer a lighter, minty vape with a gentle sweetness. This shortfill bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, leaving space for up to two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Its 70VG/30PG ratio ensures thick, satisfying clouds and rich flavour, making it ideal for sub-ohm vape kits and high-powered devices. Just Juice's Mint Range is designed for vapers who love menthol flavours, offering a range of refreshing minty blends that pair perfectly with a wide variety of vape devices.
